name: Hochschild Mining plc
research_rationale: Q3 RNS reaffirms guidance and stronger balance sheet, supporting the screen on quality and cash; FCF basis mismatch and cyclical Peru/Brazil exposure still limit conviction versus an outright buy.

weekly_updates.summary:
21 Oct Q3/9M production RNS: FY 2026 output and AISC guidance unchanged; net cash ~$91m and total cash ~$349m at 30 Sep (vs ~$51m / ~$309m at Jun).
Mara Rosa turnaround improved Q3; San Jose hit by winter weather; Royropata EIA resubmitted and Monte Do Carmo FID targeted year-end.
No new company filings since that RNS; news flow otherwise thin (Mining Forum Americas growth commentary early Oct).
